item.title: Iranian Foreign Ministry Cites Dostoevsky, Accusing US Policy of 'Reliance on Lies'
item.summary: MOSCOW (Sputnik) - Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei on Saturday quoted Elder Zosima from Russian writer Fyodor Dostoevsky's novel The Brothers Karamazov, accusing US foreign policy toward Iran and the Middle East of extreme dependence on "lies."
